    Fitting's lemma; decomposition into indecomposables; right almost split families #

    • IsIndecMod.isLocalRing: a nonzero indecomposable finite-dimensional module has a local endomorphism ring (Fitting's lemma).
    • FDMod.exists_decomp: every object is a finite direct sum of nonzero indecomposables.
    • FDMod.exists_rasFam: every nonzero indecomposable object has a right almost split family whose sources are nonzero indecomposables.
